title: West Pakistan Land Dispositions Saving of Shamilat Ordinance 1959

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Land Dispositions Saving of Shamilat Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Short title and extent

ORDINANCE I OF 1959
ORDINANCE I OF 1959
WEST PAKISTAN LAND DISPOSITIONS
(SAVING OF SHAMIL AT) ORDINANCE 1959
1. Short title and
extent.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Land
Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of West
Pakistan except the Federal Capital and the Special Areas.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Land Dispositions Saving of Shamilat Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE I OF 1959
ORDINANCE I OF 1959
WEST PAKISTAN LAND DISPOSITIONS
(SAVING OF SHAMIL AT) ORDINANCE 1959
2. Definition.‑In this Ordinance, unless there
is anything repugnant in the subject or context, the expression
"Shamilat" means land described as such in the Record of Rights, and
the land so described, shall be deemed to be Shamilat, notwithstanding that the
whole or a part of it is in the possession of one or more of the proprietors in
the estate, or of any other person.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Land Dispositions Saving of Shamilat Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Shamilat not included in disposition of land unless specifically mentioned as subject matter of the disposition

ORDINANCE I OF 1959
ORDINANCE I OF 1959
WEST PAKISTAN LAND DISPOSITIONS
(SAVING OF SHAMIL AT) ORDINANCE 1959
3. Shamilat not included
in disposition of land unless specifically men tioned as subject‑matter of the disposition.‑(1) Notwithstanding any law, usage or custom
to the contrary, in any disposition of land, whether testamentary or otherwise,
effected by the maker by means of a writing or orally and whether made before
or after the commencement of this Ordinance, words or phrase of a general
nature, purporting to convey rights or interests, incidental, contingent, or
collateral, to that land, shall not be so construed as to include therein the
Shamilat or any portion thereof appurtenant to such laid, unless such Shamilat
or a portion thereof has been specifically men tioned as the subject‑matter
of the disposition.
(2) This section shall not
affect any decision of a competent Court or authority given before the
commencement of this Ordinance : ‑
(a) if it is not open to
review, appeal or revision ; or
(b) if it is so open, no such
proceedings have been taken, and the decision has consequently become
conclusive between the parties.
